ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am a pupil (girl).
   B. I am from Kenya.
   C. I am a pupil (boy).
   D. My name is Ahmad.

2. What does the Arabic sentence أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The lamp is above the table.
   B. Where is the book?
   C. The cat is under the bed.
   D. The book is on the table.

3. Which Arabic room word is made from the words ghurfa and nawm? (1 mark)
   A. the garden
   B. the bedroom
   C. the bathroom
   D. the kitchen

4. What does hal do at the start of an Arabic question? (1 mark)
   A. It means 'the'
   B. It means 'and'
   C. It makes a yes or no question
   D. It means 'my'

5. What does the Arabic word رَقْصٌ (raqs) mean? (1 mark)
   A. please, go ahead
   B. yes
   C. dance
   D. no

6. Which Arabic sentence means "I like bananas." (1 mark)
   A. أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ
   B. أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   C. أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ
   D. آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ

7. Which sentence means 'Do you like bananas?' (1 mark)
   A. uhibbu l-mawz
   B. ashrabu l-mawz
   C. aakulu l-mawz
   D. hal tuhibbu l-mawz?

8. How is the Arabic word تُفَّاحٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. samak
   B. tuffaah
   C. shaay
   D. jazar

9. Which Arabic sentence means "I write with my hand." (1 mark)
   A. أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي
   B. أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي
   C. أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي
   D. أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي

10. Which sentence means 'I plant a tree'? (1 mark)
   A. nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a
   B. al-maa'u nadhiif
   C. azraʿu shajara
   D. laa narmii l-qumaama

11. How do you read the syllable تَ? (1 mark)
   A. buu
   B. nu
   C. tu
   D. ta

12. What is blending? (1 mark)
   A. Drawing a picture
   B. Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
   C. Writing a letter
   D. Spelling backwards

13. Which Arabic word means "lamp"? (1 mark)
   A. مِصْبَاحٌ
   B. كُرْسِيٌّ
   C. خِزَانَةٌ
   D. غُرْفَةٌ

14. What is the theme of a text? (1 mark)
   A. Its size
   B. Its main topic
   C. Its number of lines
   D. Its colour

15. Which Arabic word means "school"? (1 mark)
   A. مَدْرَسَةٌ
   B. أُسْبُوعٌ
   C. الْأَحَدُ
   D. الثُّلَاثَاءُ

16. Which Arabic word means "delicious"? (1 mark)
   A. كَعْكَةٌ
   B. يَوْمٌ
   C. لَذِيذٌ
   D. بِجَانِبِ

17. Which Arabic sentence means "I like food." (1 mark)
   A. الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ
   B. الْعَصِيرُ بَارِدٌ
   C. أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ
   D. السَّمَكُ لَذِيذٌ

18. When you time a friend reading, what matters most? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring punctuation
   B. Steady pace with correct words
   C. Reading in a whisper
   D. Being the fastest

19. What is rhyme? (1 mark)
   A. A long word
   B. A kind of picture
   C. A number
   D. Words or lines that end with the same sound

20. Which Arabic word means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. طَاوِلَةٌ
   B. مِصْبَاحٌ
   C. نَافِذَةٌ
   D. غُرْفَةٌ

21. Which Arabic sentence means "The chair is at the door." (1 mark)
   A. لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ
   B. الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ
   C. الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ
   D. أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي

22. In which direction is Arabic written? (1 mark)
   A. From left to right
   B. From the middle outwards
   C. From right to left
   D. From top to bottom only

23. Which Arabic word means "grandfather"? (1 mark)
   A. أُسْرَةٌ
   B. جَدَّةٌ
   C. أَبٌ
   D. جَدٌّ

24. Which Arabic sentence means "The table is small." (1 mark)
   A. الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ
   B. الْكُرْسِيُّ جَدِيدٌ
   C. النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ
   D. الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ

25. How is the Arabic word جَدِيدٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. fam
   B. qalam
   C. jadiid
   D. mushmis

26. What does the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bed
   B. pen
   C. book
   D. cupboard

27. Which sentence means 'I drink milk'? (1 mark)
   A. uhibbu l-khubza
   B. ashrabu l-haliiba
   C. aakulu l-aruzza
   D. as-samaku ladhiidh

28. Which Arabic word means "fish"? (1 mark)
   A. سَمَكٌ
   B. خُضَارٌ
   C. بَيْضٌ
   D. بُرْتُقَالٌ

29. What does shaping of characters mean? (1 mark)
   A. Writing very fast
   B. Writing each letter in its correct shape
   C. Using many colours
   D. Drawing pictures

30. What does the Arabic word شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. hair
   B. heart
   C. mouth
   D. finger

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Give three tips that help a speaker to use tone and pace well. (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Give three checks you should do after writing a sentence in Arabic. (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Explain the three reading strategies: decoding, cues and word spacing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into English: uhibbu T-taʿaam (2 marks)

35. Translate into English: azraʿu shajara (2 marks)

36. Explain why we celebrate special occasions and how pictures help us to understand a text. (3 marks) (3 marks)

37. Explain how drawing and labelling help you to remember new words. (2 marks) (2 marks)

38. Write the seven days in Arabic sounds and say what the first five names come from. (5 marks) (5 marks)

39. Write the Arabic greeting for 'peace be upon you' in English letters and give the reply. (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Translate into English: ʿiid miilaad saʿiid (2 marks)

41. Translate into English: haadhaa abii (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn (2 marks)

43. Complete the word شُكْ_ا with the missing letter and give its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Give two polite words for interrupting or inviting someone to speak, with meanings. (2 marks) (2 marks)

45. Give three things you can do to listen attentively. (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Describe two ways in which your class can look after the school environment. (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Explain why untidy handwriting can be a problem in Arabic. (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Put these letters in order to make a day: ت ب س. Write the word and its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a (2 marks)

50. Read the sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي and give its meaning. Say which family word it contains. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — My name is Ahmad.
   اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ (ismii Ahmad) means: My name is Ahmad.

2. B — Where is the book?
   أَيْنَ الْكِتَابُ؟ (ayna l-kitaab?) means: Where is the book?

3. B — the bedroom
   ghurfatu n-nawm means 'the room of sleep', which is the bedroom.

4. C — It makes a yes or no question
   hal begins a question that can be answered with naʿam or laa.

5. C — dance
   رَقْصٌ (raqs) means dance.

6. B — أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ
   أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

7. D — hal tuhibbu l-mawz?
   hal makes a question and tuhibbu means 'you like'.

8. B — tuffaah
   تُفَّاحٌ is read tuffaah and means apples.

9. A — أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي
   أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

10. C — azraʿu shajara
   azraʿu means I plant and shajara means tree.

11. D — ta
   تَ is read ta.

12. B — Joining syllables or sounds together to read a word
   Blending means saying the sounds one after another and joining them into a word.

13. A — مِصْبَاحٌ
   مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

14. B — Its main topic
   The theme is the main subject of the text.

15. A — مَدْرَسَةٌ
   مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) means school.

16. C — لَذِيذٌ
   لَذِيذٌ (ladhiidh) means delicious.

17. C — أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ
   أُحِبُّ الطَّعَامَ (uhibbu T-taʿaam) means: I like food.

18. B — Steady pace with correct words
   Timing helps pace, but accuracy and smoothness matter most.

19. D — Words or lines that end with the same sound
   Rhyme is when words or lines end with the same sound.

20. C — نَافِذَةٌ
   نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

21. B — الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ
   الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

22. C — From right to left
   Arabic is written from right to left.

23. D — جَدٌّ
   جَدٌّ (jadd) means grandfather.

24. D — الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ
   الطَّاوِلَةُ صَغِيرَةٌ (at-taawilatu Sagiira) means: The table is small.

25. C — jadiid
   جَدِيدٌ is read jadiid and means new.

26. D — cupboard
   خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) means cupboard.

27. B — ashrabu l-haliiba
   ashrabu means I drink and haliib means milk.

28. A — سَمَكٌ
   سَمَكٌ (samak) means fish.

29. B — Writing each letter in its correct shape
   Each letter must have its known shape so the reader can read it.

30. A — hair
   شَعْرٌ (shaʿr) means hair.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Speak loudly enough and clearly; speak at a steady speed; pause between sentences; smile when greeting.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid tip.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Did I write from right to left? Are the letters neat and joined? Are the dots and marks in place? Does the sentence make sense?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid check.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Decoding: sounding out each letter and mark. Cues: using pictures and the sentence to guess. Word spacing: looking at the spaces to see where words begin and end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each strategy.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: I plant a tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: Celebrations bring people together and give joy. Pictures show what a text is about and act as clues to new words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for celebrations and 2 marks for pictures as clues.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: The picture shows the meaning and writing the label practises the spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: al-ahad, al-ithnayn, ath-thulaathaa', al-arbiʿaa', al-khamiis, al-jumuʿa, as-sabt. The first five come from the numbers one to five.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for the days (2 for five or six, 1 for three or four) and 2 marks for the numbers clue.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. The reply is wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting and 1 mark for the correct reply.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Happy birthday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my father.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: I go to school on Monday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: شُكْرًا: the missing letter is raa (ر). It means thank you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the letter and 1 mark for the meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: ʿafwan (excuse me) and tafaddal (please, go ahead).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with meaning.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the speaker; do not talk while someone is speaking; think about the topic; listen for words you know; ask a question at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid behaviour, up to 3.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees; put rubbish in bins; keep water clean; sweep the compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way and 1 mark for a reason.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Letters that differ only by dots may look the same, so the reader may read the wrong word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dots and 1 mark for the wrong reading.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: سبت (sabt), Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: We look after the environment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: haadhihi ummii. This is my mother. It contains umm (mother).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reading, 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for the family word.
